absences: Radiant Kaleidos DOME campaign: no fuel-load, zero-power criticality or campaign-completion report found through 2026-10-21. The Q3 2026 completion target has passed unreported. Radiant's own newsroom (radiantnuclear.com) returned HTTP 403 to WebFetch, so company-side confirmation was not obtained.
Antares Mark-1 / R1: no news dated after 2026-09 found. Latest found: Space Force $161M award, 2026-09-11 (already in skip/news.json). No new post-2026-10-14 milestone.
Valar Ward 250: no news after June 2026 found, including no power, contract or delivery update for the 30 MW Utah project.
Aalo-X: no news after the 2026-07-04 criticality found.
Last Energy PWR-5: no criticality or fuel-load report found. Texas A&M story is dated 2026-05-29 (not eligible). The 2026-10-08 DSA approval is already in skip/news.json.
Natura MSR-1 (Abilene): no 2026 construction, permit or fuel news found. Only a 2024 item. The 2026-09-22 salt delivery is already in skip/news.json.

NANO Nuclear KRONOS (UIUC) and LOKI: no news after 2026-01 found. Latest is a 2026-01 MOU and a Loki lunar RFI. The company says its DOME 2027 LOKI timeline is under review after an acquisition. Oct 2026 NANO items in skip/news.json (IP3 LOI, Radnostix licence) are out of scope here.
Westinghouse eVinci: no news dated after 2026-09-15 found. The 2026-08-24 and 2026-09-03/15 criticality events are already shipped.
Steady Energy 'LOKI': no product by that name found. The only Steady Energy item found is a March 2025 funding raise. The 2026-09-15 EIB loan is already in skip/news.json.
Terra Innovatum SOLO: Brazil LOI and Illinois MOU found, but no dated item after 2026-10-14. Brazil LOI date not confirmed.
Janus program: no award, contract-signing or post-award update after 2026-08-26 found. All five awards are already in skip/news.json.
Blue Energy: 2026 news is a 2.5 GW gas-plus-BWRX-300 SMR project in Texas, outside the 1-20 MWe scope, so not recorded.

checks.claim: First new reactor design to be tested in DOE's DOME test bed. First TRISO fuel tranche received 2026-07-01; five-phase campaign (criticality → heat/power → full power → 150 h unattended continuous operation) targeting completion Q3 2026.
checks.evidence: NEI Magazine article dated 2026-08-21 says Radiant 'has dispatched its 1 MWe Kaleidos microreactor on a 1,000-mile road trip' from its El Segundo facility to INL, and that 'The entire campaign is targeted to conclude rapidly during the third quarter of 2026.' No fuel-load, zero-power criticality or campaign-completion report was found through 2026-10-21, so the Q3 2026 target has passed unreported.
checks.correction: First TRISO fuel received 2026-07-01. Kaleidos left El Segundo for INL in August 2026. Campaign was targeted to finish Q3 2026; no completion reported as of 2026-10-21.
